fields.bamaustin\n\n 2021-02-06 23:52\n\ndevelo:
Tested with version 5.1.3
The bug report is slightly misleading. Objects are saved but References connecting the Objects are lost.

Start with a fresh, blank Tree
In Families view
add a new Family (Family New Family dialog appears)
add a new Father/partner1 (Person Editor is spawned)
Given John; surname Smith (do NOT press OK button)
add a new Event (Event Reference Editor is spawned for type "Birth")
add a new Place (New Place Editor is spawned)
Name: MyCity (do NOT press OK button)
add a new enclosing Place (New Place Editor is spawned)
Name: MyCounty (do NOT press OK button)
add a new enclosing Place (New Place Editor is spawned)
Name: MyState (do NOT press OK button)

Looking at the Windows menu, the current stack is:
New Family => New Person => Event: Birth => New Place => New Place => New Place => Edit Place..

select Windows => New Family => Edit Family...
use the OK button keybinding (Alt-o)

A warning appears "Cannot save family. No data exist for this family. Please Enter data or cancel the edit." press the "Close" button

select Windows => New Family => New Person => Edit Person...
use the OK button keybinding (Alt-o)

The 2 enclosing Place windows are dismissed Leaving "MyCity"

A warning dialog appears: "Save Changes? If you close without saving, the changes you have made will be lost." options: Close without Saving, Cancel, Save
select "Save"

The Place, Event, & Person windows are closed and only the Family dialog remains with a new person named John Smith.
Click OK

However, the new John Smith has no Events. (he should have a Birth at Place

Check the Places view
The place "MyCity" was created but has no references. The 2 Enclosing levels ("MyCounty" and "MyState) are simply gone.

Check the Events view
The birth Event was NOT saved despite the indications it should have been.
fields.bamaustin\n\n 2021-09-07 23:52\n\ndevelo:
Perhaps one report could be selected to be targeted for 5.2 and the related reports consolidated and closed out as duplicates?

This issue (of References not being set to new objects when spawned dialogs closed in incorrect order) has caused a number of people problems. And since it is hard to describe, it is hard to search. So more duplicate bugs reports are likely.

It needs a raised priority because the fix(es) will need significant testing. So having a patch sooner would allow more people to beta test.

Suggestions: the reproduction process is unambiguous for https://gramps-project.org/bugs/view.php?id=12008
